title: 环形链表检测
description: 给定链表 values 与 pos，判断是否有环。
function_signature: def has_cycle(values: list, pos: int) -> bool

mock_solution.代码实现:
```python
def has_cycle(values: list, pos: int) -> bool:
    class Node:
        def __init__(self, v):
            self.val = v
            self.next = None
    if not values: return False
    nodes = [Node(v) for v in values]
    for i in range(len(nodes)-1): nodes[i].next = nodes[i+1]
    if pos >= 0: nodes[-1].next = nodes[pos]
    seen = set(); cur = nodes[0]
    while cur:
        if id(cur) in seen: return True
        seen.add(id(cur)); cur = cur.next
    return False
```

ground_truth.note: 哈希表 O(n) 空间却声称 O(1)
